title: Avoid duplicate Rust map lookups
why: Checking contains_key and then inserting the same key performs two searches of a HashMap or BTreeMap.
suggestion: Use the entry API to combine the presence check and insertion into one lookup.
limitations: Only simple identifier keys in negated contains_key guards on explicitly typed or initialized HashMap and BTreeMap variables are reported.
Aliases, complex key expressions, custom map types, and cases requiring distinct borrow behavior are not inferred.
